record.paper_title: Open problems in the theory of non-uniform hyperbolicity
record.context_brief: When condition (H) forces hyperbolic or SRB physical measures
record.original_question: Assume that a diffeomorphism f with trapping region U satisfies condition (H), namely χ_+(x, v) ≠ 0 for Lebesgue-almost every x in U and every tangent vector v ∈ T_xM. What additional conditions guarantee that an accumulation measure of μ_n = (1/n) Σ_{k=0}^{n-1} f_*^k m is hyperbolic? What additional conditions guarantee that such a physical measure is an SRB measure?

evidence.quote: Problem 7.2. What conditions should be added to the system so that (H) does imply that a physical measure (an accumulation measure of the sequence µn) is hyperbolic? is an SRB measure?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M$ be a smooth compact Riemannian manifold and let $f : M \to M$ be a $C^{1+\alpha}$ diffeomorphism. A nonempty open set $U \subset M$ is called a trapping region for $f$ if $\overline{f(U)} \subset U$. Denote by $m$ the normalized Lebesgue (Riemannian volume) measure on $M$, and for each $n \ge 1$ consider the empirical averages
$$\mu_n \;=\; \frac{1}{n}\sum_{k=0}^{n-1} f_*^k m\big|_U .$$
For $x \in M$ and $0 \neq v \in T_x M$ define the upper Lyapunov exponent
$$\chi_+(x,v) \;=\; \limsup_{n\to\infty} \frac{1}{n}\log \|D_x f^n(v)\|.$$
Say that the pair $(f,U)$ satisfies condition (H) if $\chi_+(x,v) \neq 0$ for Lebesgue-almost every $x \in U$ and every nonzero $v \in T_x M$.

An invariant Borel probability measure $\mu$ on $M$ is called a physical measure for $f$ if the set of points $x \in M$ for which $\frac{1}{n}\sum_{k=0}^{n-1}\delta_{f^k(x)} \to \mu$ in the weak-$*$ topology has positive Lebesgue measure. The measure $\mu$ is called hyperbolic if all its Lyapunov exponents are nonzero almost everywhere, and it is an SRB (Sinai–Ruelle–Bowen) measure if it has at least one positive Lyapunov exponent almost everywhere and its conditional measures on local unstable manifolds are absolutely continuous with respect to the Riemannian volume on those manifolds.

Problem. Find natural additional hypotheses on $(f,U)$, beyond condition (H), under which every weak-$*$ accumulation point of the sequence $(\mu_n)_{n\ge 1}$ is (a) a hyperbolic invariant measure, and (b) an SRB measure for $f$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open problem in a survey on non-uniform hyperbolicity. No general resolution providing sufficient additional conditions (beyond nonvanishing Lyapunov exponents on a positive Lebesgue measure set) guaranteeing hyperbolicity or the SRB property of accumulation measures of the Cesàro averages of Lebesgue measure is known; only partial results in specific settings (e.g. partially hyperbolic systems, dominated splittings) exist.
